title: (As Leslie) I can swim
setting: Saying what you can do · Level 1

branches.suggestion: Look at the lido! It opens next week. Can you swim, Mehdi?
branches.suggestionFa: استخر روباز را ببین! هفتهٔ بعد باز میشه. شنا بلدی {you}؟

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: Yes, I can swim very well.

branches.suggestion: Where did you swim in Iran? Tehran isn't by the sea, is it?
branches.suggestionFa: تو ایران کجا شنا می‌کردی؟ تهران کنار دریا نیست، نه؟

r4.speaker: mehdi
r4.text: Yes! In summer we go to the Caspian Sea.

branches.suggestion: How lovely. The lido is cold, though. Can you swim in cold water?
branches.suggestionFa: چه قشنگ. ولی استخر روباز سرده. تو آب سرد می‌تونی شنا کنی؟

r5.speaker: mehdi
r5.text: No, I can't! I like warm water.

translations.fa: نه، نمی‌تونم! آب گرم دوست دارم.

branches.suggestion: Sometimes eighteen degrees! Tom can't swim in cold water. He screams!
branches.suggestionFa: گاهی هجده درجه! تام نمی‌تونه تو آب سرد شنا کنه. جیغ می‌زنه!

branches.suggestion: Tom can swim, but he can't dive. He jumps in like a big rock! Splash!
branches.suggestionFa: تام شنا بلده، ولی شیرجه نمی‌تونه. مثل یه سنگ بزرگ می‌پره تو! شالاپ!

branches.suggestion: I can! I was in the swimming team at school. Ryan can swim really fast too.
branches.suggestionFa: بلدم! تو مدرسه عضو تیم شنا بودم. رایان هم واقعاً تند شنا می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: Nicola can swim with armbands. Let's go on Saturday! Bring a towel and a brave face!
branches.suggestionFa: نیکولا با بازوبند شنا می‌کنه. شنبه بریم! یه حوله و یه چهرهٔ شجاع بیار!
